content:
maria: heads-up — planning to land PR #27644 in tonight's canary window (ETA ~22:30 PT). CI flaky earlier, but I kicked a rerun. want to make sure we have a 20–30m buffer before the db migration at 23:15 PT.
aj: sounds good. can you hold off on merging until we confirm a clean mac-e2e pass? also +1 on buffer — last time the migration drifted.
maria: yep will hold. current CI status: mac-e2e failing on 2 tests, linux and unit are green. rerun queued.
ci-bot: PR #27644 — rerun started: mac-e2e (matrix-5/5). logs: https://ci.internal/27644/logs
maria: pinging @lee for final review when you have 10m. if all green I'll request a canary deploy and set ephemeral flag.
lee: looking now, small nits but nothing blocking. leaving review comments, approve after I push a tiny formatting fix.
maria: pushed fix and addressed one test timeout (in test harness). restarting flaky tests locally and in CI.
aj: can we add a short rollback note in the PR description so oncall can revert quickly if canary shows regressions?
maria: good call — added a runbook snippet in the PR:
```
# rollback quick commands
rb env=canary tag=v2026-03-17-2 && deploy rollback --env canary --tag $tag
# verify: curl -sS https://canary.health | jq .status
```
sanjay: also added a monitor alert for the key `inference.latency.p50` for canary with a 3x baseline threshold. if it trips, abort and revert. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: PR #27644 — mac-e2e: 5/5 passed. all tests green. artifact: gcr.io/redwood/27644:canary-20260318
maria: nice. I'll schedule canary deploy at 22:40 PT (still leaving margin for the db migration). will post here when started.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled by maria for PR #27644 at 22:40 PT. ID: deploy-7821
maria: starting canary deploy now (deploy-7821). ephemeral flag enabled `feature.new-routing=true` for 10% traffic.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started — deploy-7821. rolling to canary nodes (5/50).
aj: monitoring the rollout. if latency / errors spike, we revert immediately. please tag me in the incident channel if anything odd.
ci-bot: smoke tests passed against canary. basic traffic checks OK.
lee: eyeballing logs — a couple warnings but nothing blocking. approving merge when canary holds for 10m.
sanjay: canary metrics stable at +1m, continuing to monitor. if stable at +10m we proceed to full rollout after migration window clears.
maria: thanks all — holding merge until we confirm 10m stable and db migration completes. will update here with final decision. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
(10 minutes later)
sanjay: canary stable at +10m. migration started at 23:16 PT and is in progress; we agreed to wait for migration to finish + 5m buffer before full rollout.
maria: good — deferring merge to after migration. leaving this thread open for handoff if anyone needs to abort earlier.
aj: ack. thanks for coordinating.
(heartbeat)
maria: final — migration finished clean at 23:28 PT, waited 5m buffer. proceeding with full rollout and merging PR #27644 now. merging in 3...2...1.
deploy-bot: full rollout started for artifact gcr.io/redwood/27644:canary-20260318.
lee: nice work. will keep an eye for alerts.
sanjay: all clear from infra side. closing the loop here. :tada:
